question: Can ps-iq2xxs retrieve and aggregate THREE planted codes from one haystack in a single answer (RULER-style multi-fact retrieval), at 2K and at 64K?
method: --gate multi (ad62de55): Aurora/Borealis/Cascade codes at 15%/45%/75% of the deterministic haystack, one aggregation question requiring all three codes; neutral wording; target-only; PASS requires all three codes in one clean stop answer. Binary SHA 3235529f... unchanged.
limitations: n=1 per depth, greedy decoding; single aggregation question shape
codes are 4-digit and distinct; no numeric-confusion adversarial variants (e.g. transposed digits)
no variable haystack density or RULER word-list tasks (only the multi-needle aggregation axis)
